purpose: 五种缓存/可用性分支small/large完整样本与独立操作量，含未减少操作的cache-on观察。
scope: 形成时验收记录，非当前验证、长期benchmark或可重跑SDK。historicalPath仅标注已退出的现场来源；未保存完整源码镜像、fixture、cache、原始profile。JSON/JSONL按值转存，文本原样保留；sourceSHA256识别补存时读取的原字节，不要求原路径仍存在。

data.api: package-root defineConfig/duplicateDetection/run; outputs disabled; no change flags
data.order: alternating baseline/candidate by replicate; fresh process each sample; per-sample unique cache directory; hit seeded outside timed API interval
data.timed: one awaited public run only; import and hit preparation excluded
data.scanner: custom synthetic jscpd5.0.11 executable: actual accepted source reads, valid empty JSON; no tokenization; real process/version cost retained
data.boundary: fixtures synthetic, scanner tokenization deliberately not modeled; no Gate acceleration inference; warm filesystem likely; no atomic-source guarantee; maxRSS covers full child process incl import/hit-seed not timed-only
